DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お食事が済んだお盆は、向こうの返却口へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please take your tray to the return counter over there after finishing your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は食べ終わりましたが、友人はまだ食べています。自分の盆だけ先に返し、友人と席で待ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分だけ食後の盆を返し食事中の友人と席で待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've finished, but my friend is still eating. May I return only my tray first and wait with my friend at our seats?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can return only your finished tray and wait at your seat with your friend who is still eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご一緒にお待ちいただけます。食べ終わった分だけ、先にお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may wait together. Please return only the finished dishes first.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の器と盆だけ持って行きます。友人の器はまだ使っているので、そのまま席へ残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の器盆のみを運び使用中の友人器は残すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take only my dishes and tray. My friend is still using theirs, so I'll leave those at the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll carry only your dishes and tray, leaving your friend's dishes in use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 空いた器は、返却口の台に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put the empty dishes on the return counter's table.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 台へ置きました。箸も自分の物だけ返せました。戻ったら友人が食べるのを急がせず、少し話して待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返却できたと報告し友人を急かさず会話して待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've put them there and returned only my chopsticks too. When I go back, I'll chat and wait without rushing my friend to finish.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the return in Japanese and say you'll chat and wait without rushing your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お水を飲まれる場合は、給水場所をご利用いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you'd like water, you can use the water station.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の水を少しもらいます。友人の分はまだコップに残っているので、まず本人に要るか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の水を取り友人には残水と希望を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll get a little water for myself. My friend still has some in their glass, so I'll ask whether they want more first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll get your own water and check your friend's remaining water and wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人とも済んだ後は、席のお忘れ物にもお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've both finished, please also check that you haven't left anything at your seats.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最後にコップを返し、鞄を確認して二人で出ます。今は席へ戻って友人を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二人終了後はコップ返却と鞄確認をし今は席へ戻ると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: We'll return the glasses last, check our bags, and leave together. For now, I'll go back to wait for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll return glasses and check bags when both have finished, and return to your seat now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、どうぞごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 待つ場所について、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble finding somewhere to wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 向こうから煙が流れてきて、ここでは待ちづらいです。乗る列車の表示が見える別の場所へ移りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 流れる煙を避け列車表示が見える別待機場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Smoke is drifting over from there, making it hard to wait here. I'd like to move somewhere else where I can see my train's display.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request in Japanese another waiting spot where you can see the train display and avoid drifting smoke.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちら側にも待てる場所があります。お乗りになる列車を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: There's somewhere to wait on this side too. Which train are you taking?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次の各駅停車です。列車を変えたいのではなく、同じ便を別の場所で待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 次の各停は変えず同便を場所変更して待ちたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The next local train. I don't want to change trains; I want to wait for the same service in a different place.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll keep the next local service and just change where you wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場所なら、その便の表示も見られます。煙の状況は係で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can see that service's display from here too. Staff will check the smoke situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここへ移ります。煙はあの柱の向こうから来ていました。こちらなら煙が気にならず、列車の表示も見やすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 煙の流れた位置を示し移動先は煙が気にならず表示も見やすいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll move here. The smoke was coming from beyond that pillar. Here it doesn't bother me, and the train display is easier to see.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the smoke's origin in Japanese and say the new spot is comfortable and the display easier to see.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。お連れの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. Are you traveling with anyone?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は一人です。鞄も一緒に移しました。元の場所へ荷物を残したまま移動してはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一人で鞄も移し元場所に荷物は残していないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm alone today. I've moved my bag with me too. I haven't left luggage back at the original spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you're alone and moved your bag, leaving no luggage at the old spot.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示が変わる場合もありますので、こちらからもご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The display may change, so please keep checking it from here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 表示を見て待ちます。乗車の案内が出たら、その便の乗り場へ落ち着いて向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示変更を見て乗車案内後に落ち着いて当該乗場へ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll watch the display while waiting. When boarding information appears, I'll calmly head to that service's platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll watch for display changes and calmly head to the correct boarding area once boarding is announced.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらでお待ちください。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here, then. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 完成した飾り花を、持って来てくださったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've brought the decorative flowers you finished, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。赤と白を作りました。飾る方が選びやすいように、小さい束へ分けて渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自作赤白の飾り花を選びやすい小束へ分けて渡したいと提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I made red and white ones. I'd like to divide them into small bundles so the decorators can choose easily.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Propose in Japanese handing over your red and white decorative flowers in small bundles for easy selection.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 入口では赤、舞台の周りでは白を使います。色を混ぜず、それぞれまとめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll use red at the entrance and white around the stage. Let's group each color without mixing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 赤は入口用、白は舞台用ですね。ひと束に十個ずつ入れれば、運ぶ方が扱いやすいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤入口白舞台の用途を確認し十個束の運搬しやすさを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Red for the entrance and white for the stage, then. Would bundles of ten be easy for the carriers to handle?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm red for the entrance and white for the stage in Japanese and ask whether ten-piece bundles are easy to carry.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 十個なら持ちやすいです。今ここに何個ずつありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ten would be easy to hold. How many of each color are here now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤が二十個、白が三十個です。赤二束と白三束を作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 赤二十白三十の現数から赤二束白三束にする計画を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are twenty red and thirty white. I'll make two red bundles and three white bundles.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the twenty red and thirty white flowers in Japanese and plan two red bundles and three white bundles.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、柔らかい花がつぶれないよう、色ごとにこちらの二つの浅い箱へ並べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then arrange them by color in these two shallow boxes so the delicate flowers aren't crushed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 赤二束を一つの箱、白三束をもう一つへ並べました。上へほかの荷物を重ねないで渡せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤二束と白三束を色別の浅箱二つへ並べ上積みせず渡せると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've arranged two red bundles in one box and three white bundles in the other. I can hand them over without stacking other luggage on top.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the two red bundles and three white bundles are in separate shallow boxes and can be handed over without anything stacked on them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口と舞台の担当が、別々に取りに来ます。置いた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The entrance and stage staff will collect theirs separately. Tell them where you put them.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 浅い箱が二つで、赤は入口の担当、白は舞台の担当へ渡します。来た方には場所と束数をその場で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各担当へ色場所束数を説明して入口用舞台用を渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: There are two shallow boxes; red goes to the entrance staff and white to the stage staff. I'll explain their locations and bundle counts to whoever comes.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll give the entrance and stage staff their flowers, explaining the color, location, and bundle count.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: きれいにまとまりました。ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、飾り付けの時間にまたお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: They're neatly arranged. Thank you for helping. We'll ask for your help again at decorating time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 日用品をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for everyday essentials?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 急に友人の家へ泊まることになりました。歯ブラシと小さいタオル、靴下を買いたいです。千五百円以内にできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予定外宿泊で歯ブラシ小タオル靴下を千五百円内にそろえたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've unexpectedly arranged to stay at a friend's house. I'd like a toothbrush, small towel, and socks. Can I get them within fifteen hundred yen?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to get a toothbrush, small towel, and socks within fifteen hundred yen for an unexpected overnight stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの組合せなら、合計千三百円です。歯ブラシはケース付きで、靴下は二足入りになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This combination totals thirteen hundred yen. The toothbrush has a case, and the socks come as a two-pair pack.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その組合せにします。今夜使うのは一足ですが、残りは家でも使えるので二足入りで構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 千三百円組合せを選び二足入靴下の残りは自宅使用すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll take that combination. I'll use only one pair tonight, but I can use the other at home, so a two-pair pack is fine.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the thirteen-hundred-yen combination in Japanese and say you'll use the other pair of socks at home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: タオルには二種類の大きさがあります。こちらが小さいほうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The towel comes in two sizes. This is the smaller one.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいほうでお願いします。友人の家には体を拭く物があるので、私は顔を拭く物だけあれば足ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 友人宅に体用があるため顔用小タオルを選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The smaller one, please. My friend has something for drying my body, so I only need something for my face.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the small face towel in Japanese because your friend has a body towel.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 歯ブラシには小さなケースが付いています。持ち歩く時にお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: The toothbrush comes with a small case. Please use it when carrying it around.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ケース付きなら助かります。使った後はケースへ入れて、泊まり先から家へ持って帰れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ケース付き歯ブラシを選び使用後に入れて自宅へ持帰れると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: A case is helpful. After using it, I can put it in the case and take it home from my friend's place.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the cased toothbrush in Japanese and say you can put it away after use and take it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三点で千三百円になります。袋は一枚五円ですが、ご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The three items total thirteen hundred yen. Bags are five yen each. Would you like one?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 小さい袋を一枚お願いします。三点と袋で千三百五円ですね。千五百円以内なので、その内容でお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三点と五円袋で千三百五円と計算し千五百円以内で会計を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: One small bag, please. That's thirteen hundred and five yen for the three items and bag, right? It's within fifteen hundred, so I'll pay for that.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Calculate the three items plus a five-yen bag as thirteen hundred and five yen in Japanese and request payment within the fifteen-hundred-yen budget.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。それでは、ご友人のお宅でゆっくりお休みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Have a restful stay at your friend's home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお皿は、お下げしてもよろしいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ少し食べたいので、その皿は残してください。会話が長くなっていましたが、食事を終えたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会話中でも食事終了ではなく残る料理皿を下げないでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd still like to eat a little, so please leave that plate. We've been talking for a while, but I haven't finished my meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to keep the plate with food because conversation doesn't mean you've finished eating.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かりました。空いたほかのお皿だけお下げします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. I'll clear only the other empty plates.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空いた二皿はお願いします。残すのは焼き物の皿だけで、そこに箸も置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 空二皿は下げ焼物皿と箸は残すと具体的に指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please take the two empty ones. Leave only the grilled-food plate; my chopsticks are on it too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify in Japanese that two empty plates may be cleared but the grilled-food plate and chopsticks should remain.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 焼き物を小さい皿へ移すこともできますが、どうなさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We could also transfer the grilled food to a small plate. What would you prefer?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今の皿のままで大丈夫です。量が減っただけで、別のお料理に替えてほしいということではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小皿移替えや他料理変更は不要で現皿維持を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: The current plate is fine. There's simply less food now; I'm not asking to change it to a different dish.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose in Japanese to keep the current plate without transfer to a small plate or changing the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのままお楽しみください。飲み物を追加されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please continue enjoying it. Would you like another drink?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 水を一杯お願いします。料理を追加せず、今ある焼き物をゆっくり食べ切りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理追加なしで水一杯を頼み現料理をゆっくり食べたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: One glass of water, please. I won't order more food; I'd like to finish the grilled food I have slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request one water in Japanese without additional food and say you'd like to finish the current dish slowly.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お水をお持ちしました。空いたらまた声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's your water. Please let us know when the plate is empty.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。焼き物を食べ終えたら自分から下げてよいと伝えます。友人とも会話しながら、残りをいただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 水を受領し焼物終了後は自分から下げ可能と伝える予定を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. Once I've finished the grilled food, I'll tell you it can be cleared. I'll enjoy what's left while chatting with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the water in Japanese and say you'll tell staff when the grilled-food plate may be cleared after finishing.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり。それでは、お食事の続きをお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-KAMEOKA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take your time. Enjoy the rest of your meal.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お車でのご乗船でしょうか。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be boarding with a car?

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私は車と一緒に乗りますが、同行者は駅から歩いて来ます。乗り方が別になるので、どこで合流するか先に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 車と徒歩の別々の乗船経路で同行者との合流を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll board with my car, but my companion will walk here from the station. Since we'll board differently, I'd like to discuss where to meet in advance.
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss in Japanese where to meet your companion when boarding separately by car and on foot.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人の受付を確認します。同行者の方は、まだ到着していませんか。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check both your registrations. Has your companion not arrived yet?

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今、駅を出たと連絡がありました。私の車の列へ歩いて来てもらうのではなく、徒歩の受付へ向かってもらいます。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同行者は駅を出たと答え車列ではなく徒歩受付へ案内すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-04.translation: They just told me they've left the station. I'll have them go to pedestrian reception rather than walk to my car's queue.
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your companion has left the station and you'll direct them to pedestrian reception rather than the car queue.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの便では、それぞれの入口からご案内します。受付後の合流場所も案内図で確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-05.translation: For this sailing, we'll guide you through your separate entrances. Let's check the diagram for where to meet after registration too.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私は車の案内が終わってから客室へ行くので、同行者が先に上がっても、その間待つ場所を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車案内後に客室へ行くため先着の同行者の待機場所を決めたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll go to the passenger lounge after the vehicle guidance is over, so I'd like to decide where my companion can wait if they get aboard first.
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to choose a waiting place for your companion who may arrive before you finish vehicle guidance and reach the lounge.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 船内の案内窓口前をご案内できます。通路の中央ではなく、横の待機場所です。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can suggest the area by the onboard information desk. It's the waiting space beside it, not the center of the passage.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内窓口横ですね。同行者へ図を送り、私が客室へ着いたら連絡すると伝えます。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 船内案内窓口横の図を送り到着後連絡する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-08.translation: Beside the information desk, then. I'll send my companion the diagram and say I'll contact them when I reach the passenger lounge.
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll send the diagram of the area beside the onboard information desk and contact your companion on arrival.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの券も、ご自身で持って受付へお進みください。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please each carry your own ticket and proceed to registration.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同行者は自分の券を持っています。別々に受付を済ませてから、案内窓口横で会う予定を共有できました。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 各自の券を保持し別受付後に窓口横で会う共有済み予定を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-10.translation: My companion has their own ticket. We've agreed to register separately and meet beside the information desk afterward.
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that each has their ticket and you've agreed to meet beside the desk after separate registration.

DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、お客様は車の受付へどうぞ。それでは、お二人でよい船旅を。
DLG-SC-KYT-MAIZURU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to vehicle registration, then. Have a lovely sailing together.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この列の箱を、二人で確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could the two of you check the boxes in this row?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、二人とも動かしながら数えると同じ箱を二回数えそうです。私は数える役にしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ箱の二重計数を防ぎ自分は数える役を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But if we both count while moving them, we might count the same box twice. May I take the counting role?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Offer in Japanese to do the counting to prevent counting a box twice.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それで進めましょう。もう一人が箱を置いたら、一箱ずつ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's do that. After the other person sets a box down, check it one at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 置かれた箱を見て数えます。持ち上げた時点ではまだ増やさず、置き終わりに合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 置き終わりを合図に数え持上げ時点では増やさないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll count the boxes once they're placed. I won't add one when it's lifted; I'll count when it's fully set down.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you'll count on placement, not at lifting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数え終えた箱は、手前から奥へ並びます。今、何箱ありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Counted boxes will line up from front to back. How many are there now?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手前の列に四箱です。次の箱を奥へ置いてもらったら五箱になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現列四箱で次箱設置後五箱になると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are four in the front row. Once the next box is placed at the back, there will be five.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there are four now and will be five after the next is placed.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 五箱目が置かれました。運んだ方にも、置いた数を聞いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The fifth box is down. Ask the carrier how many they've placed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その方も五箱と答えました。私の数と合っているので、ここまでを五として記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬者の五箱回答と一致し現在五箱を記録すると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: They also said five. That matches my count, so I'll record five up to this point.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that the carrier's five matches yours and you'll record five now.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 途中で別の箱を足す時は、声を掛け合ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please call out to each other when adding other boxes along the way.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追加が来たら、いったん今の五箱を共有してから続けます。運ぶ方が途中で替わる時も、その数から引き継げるよう記録を見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加前に五箱を共有し運搬者交代時もその実数と記録から引き継ぐと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: When more arrive, we'll first share the current count of five before continuing. If the carrier changes, I'll show the record so they can take over from that count too.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll share five before additions and hand over that actual count and record if the carrier changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 役割と数を合わせられましたね。それでは、この方法で次の担当と続けてください。お疲れさまです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've aligned the roles and count. Please continue with the next person using this method. Thank you for your work.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの魚を切り身にしてご用意しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like us to cut this fish into portions?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。切り身は焼いて食べ、残るあらは汁物に使いたいので、捨てずに一緒に受け取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 魚の切身と汁物用のあらを両方希望し廃棄せず渡してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'll grill the portions and use the remaining head and bones for soup, so I'd like those included rather than discarded.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request both fish portions and soup trimmings in Japanese, asking that the trimmings not be discarded.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 切り身とあらを、別の包みにします。調理方法について詳しく知りたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll wrap the portions and trimmings separately. Is there anything you'd like to know in detail about cooking them?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下処理について家で調べてから使います。今日は切り身の包みと、あらの包みを分けて渡していただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 調理前に下処理を調べ切身とあらは個別包装を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll research preparation at home before using them. Today I'd like the portions and trimmings handed over in separate packages.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll research preparation before cooking and request separate packages for portions and trimmings.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。切り身は二つの大きさに分けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Certainly. Would you like the portions cut into two sizes?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じくらいの二切れにしてください。二人の食事用で、あらは別の日の汁物にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二人用に同程度の二切れを指定しあらは別の汁物用と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please make two pieces of about the same size. They're for a meal for two, and I'll use the trimmings for soup another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify two similarly sized pieces for two people in Japanese and explain the trimmings are for another day's soup.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二切れをご用意しました。こちらがあらの包みです。持ち帰り用の保冷袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The two pieces are ready. Here's the package of trimmings. Do you have an insulated bag for taking them home?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。この袋に二つの包みを入れます。あらを先に使うかは、保管の表示も見て決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保冷袋を示し包みを分けたまま入れ表示を見て使用順を考える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll put both packages in this bag. I'll check the storage labels too before deciding whether to use the trimmings first.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your insulated bag in Japanese, keep the packages separate inside it, and consider the use order after checking labels.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品に付けた表示をお読みください。不明な点は、調理前にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please read the labels attached to the products. Ask us about anything unclear before cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの包みと表示を受け取れました。今日はこのまま帰宅し、切り身とあらを別の使い道で管理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二包みと表示を受領し直帰して用途別に管理すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received both packages and their labels. I'll go straight home now and manage the portions and trimmings for their separate uses.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge both labeled packages in Japanese and say you'll go straight home and manage them by intended use.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文のカレーをお持ちする前に、何かご用意しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before bringing your curry, can we prepare anything for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 午後に仕事へ戻るので、上着を汚したくありません。紙のエプロンがあれば使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 午後仕事へ戻るため上着汚れを避け紙エプロンを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll return to work this afternoon, so I don't want to stain my jacket. I'd like a paper apron if you have one.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request a paper apron in Japanese to avoid staining your jacket before returning to work in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お使いいただけます。上着はこちらのフックへ掛けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use one. Would you like to hang your jacket on this hook?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、上着を先に掛けます。シャツにも飛ばないよう、エプロンを付けてから食べ始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 上着をフックへ掛けシャツを守るためエプロン後に食べると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I'll hang it up first. I'll put the apron on before eating so nothing splashes onto my shirt either.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you'll hang the jacket and put the apron on before eating to protect your shirt too.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらのエプロンをどうぞ。ひもは後ろで留める形です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here's your apron. The ties fasten at the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。前のひもが器に入らないよう、留めてから席へ座ります。料理はその後で置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ひもを留めてから座るため料理設置を準備後に頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll fasten it before sitting so the front ties don't fall into the bowl. Could you put the food down afterward?
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the food to be set down after you're ready, since you'll fasten the ties before sitting.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご準備ができたらお持ちします。エプロンは付けられましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll bring it when you're ready. Have you got the apron on?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 付けられました。首の所がきつかったので少しゆるめ、前はシャツを覆っています。今、お料理をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 装着でき首は適度にゆるめ前面を覆ったと伝え料理を受ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It was tight at the neck, so I loosened it a little, and the front covers my shirt. Please bring the food now.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the apron is on, the neck loosened appropriately, and the front covers your shirt, then receive the food.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: カレーはこちらです。使い終えたエプロンは、こちらの回収かごへお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's your curry. Please put the used apron in this collection basket afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 食後は回収かごへ入れます。上着はまだフックにあるので、立つ時に忘れず受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食後のエプロン回収とフックの上着回収を覚えていると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll put it in the basket after eating. My jacket is still on the hook, so I'll remember to collect it when I stand up.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you remember returning the apron after eating and collecting your jacket from the hook.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ温かいうちにお召し上がりください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please enjoy it while it's hot. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 以前のご相談に関するご連絡でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us about an earlier consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。先週こちらで相談した後、携帯の番号を変えました。前の番号では連絡が取れなくなったので、お知らせに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週の相談後に携帯番号が変わり旧番号連絡不可と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I changed my mobile number after consulting here last week. The old number no longer works, so I came to let you know.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your mobile number changed after last week's consultation and the old number can't be reached.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 対応した担当の名前や、ご相談の日時は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the staff member's name or the consultation date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 木曜の午後二時ごろで、担当名をこのメモに控えています。新しい出来事を相談したいのではなく、連絡先の変更です。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前回日時と担当メモを示し新件ではなく連絡先変更と限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was around two on Thursday afternoon, and I noted the staff member's name here. This isn't a new incident to discuss; it's a contact-details change.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the previous time and staff-name note in Japanese and limit the purpose to contact change rather than a new case.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人と相談の内容を確認して、担当へ伝えます。新しい番号を紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll confirm your identity and consultation and tell the responsible staff. Could you write your new number on paper?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここへ書きます。以前の番号はもう使っていません。二つとも連絡できると受け取られないよう、その点も添えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新番号を書き旧番号も使える状態ではないと明記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write it here. I no longer use the old number. I'll add that so nobody thinks both numbers can be used to reach me.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write the new number and state explicitly in Japanese that the old number is no longer usable.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい番号で連絡を受けやすい時間はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: When is it easiest to reach you at the new number?

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平日は仕事中なので、休憩の正午か午後六時以降です。急ぎの連絡については、担当と方法を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正午か十八時以降が受けやすく急ぎ連絡方法は担当確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm at work on weekdays, so noon during my break or after six p.m. For urgent contact, I'd like to confirm the method with the staff member.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that noon or after six is convenient and you want to confirm urgent-contact methods with the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の時間も伝えますが、連絡時刻をここで確約することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on your preferred times too, but I can't guarantee a call time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 希望として伝えてください。旧番号が使えないこと、新番号、受けやすい時間の三点をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間は希望として旧番号無効と新番号とともに三点を渡す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please pass them on as preferences. I'll give you three points: the old number doesn't work, my new number, and convenient contact times.
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the old number's invalidity, new number, and preferred times in Japanese, with times presented as requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、ご連絡ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-KYT-MAIZURU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll hand this over to the staff member. Thank you for letting us know. Take care.
